scope: sum of unique uncompressed primitive .npy numeric members plus 4096 bytes per member; cardinality is bounded by all 80 cells and all 532 modes with no observed-class shortcut and no payload-deduplication credit; excludes process RSS, separately bounded callback/control JSON and logs, separately bounded JIT and temp files, filesystem reserve, and any final compressed archive (no duplicate archive is created)

derivation.raw_tensors_exact_shape_formula: 80 unique complex128 tensors x 882 x 882; one worst-case distinct class per exact-geometry cell
derivation.raw_coordinates_exact_shape_formula: 80 unique float64 coordinate tables x 8 vertices x 3 coordinates
derivation.all_orientation_csr_exact_shape_formula: 80 orientations x (883 int64 indptr + 882x882 int64 indices + 882x882 complex128 values); no observed-orientation shortcut
derivation.all_zero_Hlocal_exact_shape_formula: 80 cells x 532 x 532 complex128; conservative per-cell full-mode square even though payload is exactly zero
derivation.4096_byte_npy_headers_exact_shape_formul: 3564 unique members x 4096 bytes each; includes one raw tensor and coordinate table for each of 80 cells
derivation.cardinality_assumptions: all 80 exact-geometry cells may have distinct raw tensor/coordinate payloads; all 80 orientations may have distinct dense-upper CSR payloads; all 532 modes; 64-bit indices where applicable; no payload deduplication credit

stop_semantics: admit each complete unique member before synchronous export; if the next complete member would exceed the frozen limit, stop with controlled_stop and preserve all prior members without clipping or classifying partial evidence as pass
independent_checker_requirement: require exact frozen cap identity and exact member/role closure; recompute member numeric bytes and headers; reject missing, orphan, or extra members

separate_resource_gates.authority: external supervisor measurements and disk-category guard; this JSON is not a measurement; the 2 GiB free reserve alone does not guarantee capacity for the full 8 GiB raw cap
